summary: Tech and camel civ that ages up through House of Wisdom wings instead of landmarks. Buildings packed around the House of Wisdom push it into a Golden Age that keeps growing its economy.

spikes.label: Wing choice sets the plan
spikes.detail: Abbasid reach Feudal without pulling villagers off work. The first wing tells you their plan: Economy for a boom, Military for early pressure, Culture for upgrades.
spikes.answer: Scout the House of Wisdom right after they age up. Against an Economy wing, punish with early pressure on their berries and wood lines.

spikes.label: Camel army
spikes.detail: Camel Archers and Camel Riders weaken nearby horse cavalry, and Ghulams join in Castle Age. Knight and horseman armies trade badly into them.
spikes.answer: Answer camels with Spearmen, Crossbows and Men-at-Arms rather than horse cavalry.

spikes.label: Golden Age economy
spikes.detail: The Golden Age has five tiers in the current patch, so a game left alone into Imperial favors the Abbasid economy.
spikes.answer: Pressure before the Golden Age stacks up and target buildings around the House of Wisdom.

scout: Which House of Wisdom wing they pick first
Houses and buildings clustered tightly around the House of Wisdom, which means a Golden Age push
Mills on berries (Orchards); Abbasid cannot gather boar, so berries are their main early food

pairings.why: The standard Feudal pair that covers cavalry raids and trades well against infantry.
Ranged damage behind a sturdy melee line, and the camels blunt enemy horse cavalry.

winConditions.detail: Outscale through Golden Age bonuses and cheap traders.
Land traders are a third cheaper, so long trade routes pay off on open maps.
